summary: pi (pi.dev) is an export-only compatibility target: runtime/drivers/pi/export.py renders z-harness agents/skills as pi agent/prompt files, copies vendored pi-only assets and deterministic /z-resume runtime scripts, and applies four layers of YAML frontmatter defense; no adapter/HostDriver exists, unlike OMP's native T009 support.

entry_points.summary: Public entry: export(repo_root, export_root, *, options=None) -> ExportResult; builds full exports/pi/ tree
Package init: re-exports export(); documents export-only asymmetry (no adapter, no HostDriver)
Maps Claude Code/z-harness tool names to pi tool names (Glob -> find)
Tools dropped from agent allowlists on export (agent, task, webfetch, websearch, etc.)
Rewrites Agent()/Skill() lines and AskUserQuestion()/TaskCreate()/SubagentCreate()/EnterPlanMode()/ExitPlanMode() lines to pi subagent/skill/inline hints; handles prose AskUserQuestion refs
Quotes YAML scalar values containing colons/brackets/hashes/quotes; preventive layer against pi YAML parse failures
Renders z-harness agent as pi agent .md with _yaml_quote, semantic model tier mapping (haiku->flash, sonnet/opus->pro), _TOOL_MAP
Renders command as pi prompt .md; injects prompt defense after heading if no sentinel marker found
Post-export strict YAML 1.2 validation via yaml.safe_load(); silently skips if PyYAML unavailable
Copies deterministic /z-resume runtime scripts into export root's scripts/... paths; gated on source repo having scripts/resume-context.py; shared across host drivers
Standalone source-tree frontmatter lint; wired into make lint-frontmatter and CI at tests.yml:55
make lint-frontmatter invokes scripts/lint-frontmatter.sh; wired into CI (.github/workflows/tests.yml:55)
Fan-out rule preamble for AGENTS.md; encodes doc-fetcher first, explore for gaps discipline
pi-only read-only fan-out recon agent; parallel dispatch via subagent tasks:[...] syntax
pi subagent extension entry point; registers subagent tool, discovers agents from ~/.pi/agent/agents/*.md
Agent loader: parses YAML frontmatter from agent .md files, normalizes fields, resolves tool allowlists
Instructions for refreshing the vendored subagent extension after a pi upgrade

invariants: pi is EXPORT-ONLY: no adapter, no HostDriver, no --host pi, no launch/inject host; all interaction is through the exported resource files
skills/<id>/SKILL.md is the prompt source; commands/ is retained only as a back-compat enumerate_sources key and is normally empty in the current tree
pi-only assets (explore.md, subagent extension, AGENTS preamble, CAPABILITIES.md, README.md) live in scripts/pi_assets/ and are copied verbatim

Asset path resolution is __file__-relative (MINOR-7): module walks up 3 levels from runtime/drivers/pi/export.py to repo root then descends into scripts/pi_assets/; standalone-importable without z_harness_cli
Agent descriptions pass through _yaml_quote to prevent YAML parse failures on colons/brackets/quotes in pi's frontmatter parser
Post-export validation (_validate_frontmatter_yaml) re-validates every agent file with a strict YAML 1.2 parser; silently skips if PyYAML unavailable
Model tiers are mapped on export: haiku->deepseek-v4-flash, sonnet/opus->deepseek-v4-pro; agents without a tier inherit pi's default
Unsupported constructs (Agent, Skill, AskUserQuestion, TaskCreate, SubagentCreate, EnterPlanMode, ExitPlanMode) are rewritten line-by-line to pi hints, never silently dropped
make lint-frontmatter is wired into CI at .github/workflows/tests.yml:55; frontmatter regressions are caught at PR time
OMP support is separate from pi export; OMP paths must not reuse pi prompt rewrites, scripts/pi_assets, or the vendored subagent extension.
pi remains export-only while OMP is a first-class native host (T009 complete: fidelity='native', four command families native).

export() also copies the deterministic /z-resume runtime script set (export_resume_runtime_scripts) into the export root when the source repo has scripts/resume-context.py; this helper is shared across host drivers, not pi-specific.
gotchas: pi has no native subagent dispatch — fan-out runs through the vendored extensions/subagent/ extension which spawns isolated pi child processes
skills/<id>/SKILL.md is the source for prompts; commands/ is normally empty and retained only as a back-compat source key
Asset resolution uses __file__-relative logic; moving export.py without moving scripts/pi_assets/ will break standalone-import fallback path

YAML frontmatter parser bug (resolved 2026-06-08): four-layer defense: (1) pi runtime quoteUnquotedColonValues() + catch-and-retry; (2) source quoting in pi_assets/agents/explore.md; (3) _yaml_quote for all generated agent descriptions; (4) _validate_frontmatter_yaml post-export strict YAML 1.2 re-validation
_validate_frontmatter_yaml silently skips if PyYAML is not installed — export succeeds but strict YAML gate is bypassed
Multi-line Agent()/Skill() call rewrites are line-based; argument lines on subsequent lines are not rewritten
Many internal agents assume a driving orchestrator and may not be useful as standalone one-shot pi subagents; doc-fetcher and explore are the headline fan-out agents
Agents are discovered from ~/.pi/agent/agents/*.md — NOT a pi package resource type; must be symlinked separately even when z-harness is installed as a pi package
The subagent extension at the export root's extensions/subagent/ is a vendored copy that must be refreshed after pi upgrades (see VENDOR.md)
Do not infer OMP behavior from pi export behavior; OMP has its own frozen argv/prompt/output/event/session/profile/rules/model contract and is now native (T007/T009).
.omp/config.yml belongs to OMP sessions, not pi export; it intentionally suppresses project AGENTS autoloading.

runtime/tests/test_export_golden.py (previously the documented pi golden-snapshot consumer) was deleted 2026-06-18; current pi export coverage lives in runtime/tests/test_export_utils.py (TestPiLegacyAgentRewrite, TestPiLegacyAssetDocs) and runtime/tests/test_omp_export.py (forbidden-cross-use guard).

runtime/tests/test_export_utils.py::TestPiLegacyAssetDocs asserts against a committed exports/pi/README.md and exports/pi/CAPABILITIES.md that do not exist in this checkout (export output now goes to scratch roots like temp/exports/pi/); 3 of its assertions currently fail with FileNotFoundError — appears to be pre-existing test/tree drift, not something this doc refresh should paper over.
There is no docs/llm/export-utils.json concept doc yet even though _export_utils.py is a real dependency; depends_on keeps the export-utils reference as a placeholder for when that doc is written.

memories.text: Subagent YAML dispatch bug resolved. pi's YAML frontmatter parser (dist/utils/frontmatter.js) could fail to parse agent .md files when the description field contained an unquoted colon (triggered by 'subagent `tasks: [...]`' in explore.md). Three-layer defense applied: (1) pi runtime patched with quoteUnquotedColonValues() + catch-and-retry in frontmatter.js; (2) scripts/pi_assets/agents/explore.md description quoted at source; (3) exports/pi/agents/explore.md description quoted (generated from source). Additionally, runtime/drivers/pi/export.py:193 _yaml_quote already prevents this for all generated agent files by quoting any description containing regex [:[]{}#"'].

Post-review YAML validation hardening. Three additions: (1) runtime/drivers/pi/export.py:295 _validate_frontmatter_yaml() re-validates every generated/copied agent file with yaml.safe_load() — strict YAML 1.2 parser — after the custom regex frontmatter parser passes; imports yaml with silent skip fallback. (2) scripts/lint-frontmatter.sh scans agents/, skills/, commands/, personas/, scripts/pi_assets/ for .md frontmatter and validates with strict YAML 1.2 parser; wired into make lint-frontmatter. (3) Two infra issues posted: runtime/drivers/pi/export.py copied assets bypass _yaml_quote (only generated agents get quoting), and make lint-frontmatter is not wired into CI (.github/workflows/tests.yml). The CI gap means frontmatter regressions can land on main undetected until the next export.

native_omp_boundary.pi: export-only compatibility target: no adapter, no HostDriver, no --host pi, no launch/inject
native_omp_boundary.omp_native: first-class native host (T009 complete): OmpAdapter fidelity='native', OmpHostDriver native dispatch (T007), .omp/z-harness package discovery, four native command families (z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel), all others degraded; Claude Code is parity ground truth
forbidden_cross_use: vendored pi subagent extension from OMP support
native_omp_boundary.consult_boundary: scripts/omp-consult.sh adapts provider-registry consults using --no-rules --no-session; it is not OMP command dispatch
